chunks.title: Microwave Warranty
chunks.content: All PEL Microwaves come with a 2-Year Magnetron Warranty.

chunks.model: PMO-20 W/B M CLASSIC, PMO-20 BH CLASSIC PLUS, PMO-23 SLM SILVER LINE, PMO-23 SLD SILVER LINE
chunks.title: Solo Series (Manual & Digital)
chunks.content: Solo models provide basic microwave functionality. Manual models use dials, while the SLD Silver Line features a digital touch panel.

chunks.model: PMO-23/26/30 DESIRE, PMO-23/26 CHEF, PMO-30 BG GLAMOUR
chunks.title: Digital Grill Models
chunks.content: The Desire, Chef, and Glamour series feature digital touch panels and an added Grill function for crispy food tops.

chunks.model: PMO-25/30 CONVECTION, PMO-23/28 KITCHEN PRO GR, PMO-26 KITCHEN PRO CAF, PMO-30 KITCHEN PRO ICAF
chunks.title: Convection & Kitchen Pro Air Fryer Models
chunks.content: Convection models (25L/30L) add baking capabilities. The high-end Kitchen Pro series offers advanced features like Air Frying (PMO-26 KITCHEN PRO CAF) and Inverter technology combined with Air Frying (PMO-30 KITCHEN PRO ICAF).
